title: Mohinder Singh Gill v. Chief Election Commissioner

content.caseIdentity: Mohinder Singh Gill v. Chief Election Commissioner, (1978) 1 SCC 405
content.holding: Article 324 is a plenary reservoir of inherent power to conduct free and fair elections where statutory law is silent; ECI has power to cancel polls and order repolls.
content.relevance: Locus classicus on plenary residual powers of the Election Commission.

evidence.note: 5-Judge Constitution Bench judgment in Civil Appeal No. 2109 of 1977; 1977 INSC 220; (1978) 1 SCC 405; 1978 (2) SCR 272.
